title: Senior .NET Developer
excerpt: Build and scale cloud APIs in C# and .NET for a US fintech client, working in US Central hours.

body: We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join a US fintech product team that serves thousands of small businesses. You will own backend services end to end: from designing APIs and data models to shipping them to Azure and keeping them healthy in production.

You will work daily with the client’s product managers and engineers, take part in architecture decisions, and mentor mid-level developers on the team. Our stack is .NET 8, C#, Azure Functions, Azure SQL and Service Bus, with React on the front end.
responsibilities: Design, build and maintain RESTful APIs and background services in C# and .NET 8.
Model data and write performant queries for Azure SQL / SQL Server.
Collaborate with product and design to break features into well-scoped work.
Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and share knowledge.
Own CI/CD pipelines and observability for your services.
Mentor mid-level developers and contribute to engineering standards.
requirements: 5+ years of professional experience with C# and .NET.
Hands-on experience with Azure (Functions, App Service, Service Bus or similar).
Solid SQL skills and experience with Entity Framework or Dapper.
Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher, written and spoken.

aboutCompany: NicaSource is a nearshore staff augmentation company based in Managua, Nicaragua, since 2013. We embed pre-vetted Latin American engineers, designers and QA specialists into product teams across the US and beyond, working in their time zone and inside their workflow from day one.
Our people grow with us: every teammate gets NS Time — 8 paid hours a week for training, internal syncs and team moments — plus a community of 100+ professionals who share what they learn.
sections.benefitsIntro: We take care of the people who take care of our clients. Beyond a competitive USD salary, you get the flexibility of a remote-first team and the support of a company that invests in your career.

benefits.title: Remote first
benefits.body: Work from anywhere in LATAM with a schedule that overlaps your US team. We cover your internet and a home-office stipend.

benefits.title: NS Time
benefits.body: 8 paid hours every week for training, certifications, internal syncs and team moments, built into your 40-hour week.

benefits.title: Flexible time off
benefits.body: Paid vacation, local holidays and personal days you actually take. Plan them with your team and your client, without the guilt.
